welcome.hero.title: Riding School
welcome.hero.description: Konjeniški klub Karlo – over 100 members, 9 school horses and riding for all ages. Beginner courses, advanced programmes, competition training and relaxed trail riding above Maribor.
welcome.about.title: Riding school for all
welcome.about.p1: The riding school offers beginner and advanced courses. Lessons run Tuesday to Sunday for two hours, even in winter.
welcome.about.p2b: of various breeds and sizes, calm and friendly, suitable for riders of all ages. Riding is possible in
welcome.about.p2arenas: the outdoor arena and the covered indoor hall
welcome.about.p3: The riding school is not only about learning riding skills – we develop responsibility, respect for animals, independence, cooperation and self-confidence. The programme prepares riders for the Rider 1 and Rider 2 exams.
welcome.programs.title: What we offer
welcome.programs.subtitle: From the first contact with a horse to competition training – KK Karlo has a programme for every level.
welcome.program1.title: Riding School
welcome.program1.subtitle: Beginner course
welcome.program1.description: Beginner and intermediate riding courses. Lessons run Tuesday to Sunday for two hours, even in winter. Ideal for children and adult beginners.
welcome.program2.title: Advanced course
welcome.program2.subtitle: Intensive training
welcome.program2.description: Preparation for competition licences. Intensive training in small groups with individual attention. Dressage work and jumping.
welcome.program3.title: Trail riding
welcome.program3.subtitle: Tourist riding
welcome.program3.description: Relaxed trail riding through nature above Maribor. Ideal for group visits and individuals seeking contact with nature and horses.
welcome.pricing.title: Transparent service prices
welcome.pricing.subtitle: VAT is included. Prices valid until 1 March 2026, after which a new price list applies.
welcome.pricing.hours: Available Tuesday to Saturday between 8:00 and 16:00
welcome.nature.title: Experience riding in nature
welcome.nature.description: A beautiful setting just 5 km from Maribor centre – Kovačič Farm. Trail riding, local produce, wine from our own vineyard and wellness at Hotel Frost. Ideal for group visits, excursions and special occasions.
welcome.footer.clubDescription: Over 100 members enjoying horse riding in nature above Maribor. It's not just sport – it's an experience with horses, community and connection to nature.
